title: Optimize canary/AB/shadow auto-rollback workflow and add stability guards
author: Aisha Thompson
description: Motivation: we've observed noisy rollback triggers in the unified rollout auto-rollback engine when canaries receive transient anomalies (region blips, quantized model edge cases). This PR reduces false-positive rollbacks by (1) introducing a debounce window for metric anomalies, (2) adding a lightweight quorum across multiple telemetry sources (latency, error-rate, model-confidence), (3) exposing a stability_guard config for per-rollout thresholds, and (4) refactoring decision/eval flow to make probes idempotent. Changes are backwards-compatible: defaults preserve current behavior but with reduced sensitivity to transient spikes. Checklist: - [x] design doc (linear/ENG-4821) - [x] unit tests for decision engine - [x] e2e stability test harness updates - [x] add runtime metrics & traces - [x] staged rollout in canary cluster - [x] rollout monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/rollouts/guard-optimizations Notes: The description below lists the high-level changes and rationale. Key points: * Debounce window: 30s default window with exponential backoff on repeated anomalies. This filters short-lived spikes from triggering immediate rollback. * Metric quorum: require 2/3 signal alignment across configured metrics before initiating rollback sequence. Metrics are configurable per rollout via stability_guard. * Probe idempotency: probes now store a short-lived probe_id in KV cache to avoid double-counting the same probe across retries. * Observability: added per-rollout trace spans, new metrics rollout.rollback_candidates and rollout.quorum_match_rate. * Safety: fallback to manual quarantine if quorum is marginal and any critical SLA breaches are detected. Rollout: staged rollout on internal canary fleet for 48h, then gradual enablement for reported customers. Backports: small hotfix included to avoid a race when probe cancellations overlap with canary weight updates. See commits for details.

release_notes: Reduce false-positive automatic rollbacks by adding stability_guard (debounce + metric quorum). Backwards-compatible default; ops can tune stability_guard per rollout. Includes observability metrics rollout.quorum_match_rate and rollout.rollback_candidates.
notes_for_release: Operator impact: none by default. To opt-in, set stability_guard in rollout config.
Rollback behavior: fewer spurious rollbacks on short-lived anomalies; in marginal cases system quarantines rollout instead of immediate rollback.
